ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota and examine the state's efforts to prevent and detect fraud.
questions: What are the most common types of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to child care fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover patterns of fraud and abuse in child care programs, and highlight the need for stronger oversight and accountability.
